purpose: Prospectively test the three frozen Validation v2 research candidates using current OddsPapi Bet365 main-line observations without retrospective line selection or threshold tuning.

data_source.mainline_requirement: AH and OU observations are admissible only when the current provider payload identifies one unambiguous main line with explicit mainLine=true on both sides.
data_source.fixture_join: exact OddsPapi fixture_id only; fuzzy team/date joining is prohibited

collection_policy.quota_intent: Keep normal current-odds usage near 120-124 requests per month while avoiding the provider HTTP 400 observed with one 10-tournament request.
collection_policy.cadence_change_reason: The first 10-tournament engineering request returned HTTP 400 before any candidate outcome was evaluated. Split batching and the 12-hour cadence were frozen before forward entries were allowed to begin.

entry_policy.entry_definition: the first scheduled observer snapshot after this preregistration amendment is locked that satisfies every frozen condition for that candidate

closing_and_clv_policy.closing_definition: the latest admissible prospectively observed main-line snapshot strictly before kickoff for the same fixture
closing_and_clv_policy.label: LATEST_OBSERVED_PREMATCH_MAINLINE
closing_and_clv_policy.clv_price_definition: entry decimal price divided by latest-observed same-selection decimal price minus 1

settlement_policy.abandoned_void_rule: unsettled, abandoned, cancelled, or result-unavailable fixtures are excluded from settled-bet performance and reported separately
settlement_policy.asian_handicap: settle exact quarter line including half-win and half-loss outcomes; never round the line
settlement_policy.over_under: settle exact total line; candidate FD_OU25_D0A17AE7DB9C is Under 2.5
settlement_policy.profit_units: net return on one flat stake unit

anti_p_hacking_rule: Do not change candidate thresholds, price/probability bands, line definitions, entry timing, one-entry rule, sample minimums, CLV definition, settlement rules, or forward gates after inspecting forward candidate outcomes. Any material change creates a new hypothesis and requires a new untouched forward sample.
notes: The three candidates were selected retrospectively and therefore cannot become production patterns solely by passing this paper stage.
Twelve-hour collection cadence is quota-aware, so latest observed pre-match odds must not be described as the exact bookmaker closing tick.
The split-batch/cadence amendment was made in response to an HTTP 400 engineering failure before any forward candidate result was evaluated.
Forward evidence begins only after this amended preregistration; earlier diagnostic or engineering observations cannot be promoted into candidate entries retroactively.
